# Healthcare Award Pay Rates 2026: Employer Compliance Guide
- From 1 July 2026, all award rates increased by 4.75% following the Fair Work Commission Annual Wage Review — Support Services Level 1 starts at $26.97/hour

## Penalty Rates and Shift Loading
- ✓Support Services Level 1 minimum rate from 1 July 2026 is $26.97/hour ($1,024.70/week for 38 hours)

## Frequently Asked Questions
Under MA000027, Saturday work pays 150% of the minimum hourly rate for full-time and part-time employees, and 175% for casuals (which includes the 25% casual loading).

Overtime under MA000027 is paid at 150% of the minimum hourly rate for the first 2 hours and 200% after that.

## What decides the rate
### The qualification level for the profession
The one with a bachelor sits at AQF 7, on an award minimum of about $68,300 a year. The one with a masters sits at AQF 9, on about $75,400.

### The duties performed, above Level 1
Level 2 pays a little over $101,000 a year at the first stage, roughly $13,000 more than an AQF 7 clinician with seven or more years in the profession.
